series.A: *“Other Movies” and “Other Shows” rows in this report capture total viewing from titles with <50k views. Additionally, all video podcasts are calculated under “Other Shows”. These rows allow the report to reflect 100% of viewing. “Other” in 2025 H1 totalled 662,600,000 view hours.
